messages:
Incident Bot: HIGH — paging on-call for incidents/incidents. Customer NOVA-HEALTH (enterprise VPC) reports widespread 429s from their dedicated pool since 2026-03-15T12:12Z. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat, /v1/embeddings. Please ack and start mitigation.

Maya: acked — I'm oncall. @Lin can you paste the customer's error payloads and any headers? Any recent deploys on their side?

Lin: Customer reports start ~12:12Z, ~40% fail rate for prod traffic. They pasted one example: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: novah-req-987e
{ "error": "rate_limited", "detail": "tenant_quota_exceeded", "quota_id": "tenant_quota_vpc_nova" }
```
They say they did not change client-side config. Contract shows reserved pool + burst privileges but CS unsure if override is in place.

Maya: thanks. Andy — can you check dedicated pool telemetry and tenant throttle enforcement? Quick checks: pool utilization, token/s, per-tenant counters.

Andy: pulling metrics now. snippets: 
```
pool:nova-enterprise-1.utilization = 0.93
pool:nova-enterprise-1.active_requests = 1420
rate_limit_events{tenant="nova-health"}  = 412 (since 12:00Z)
429_spike 12:11Z -> 12:20Z: 38/s peak
```
Looks like tenant-level limit gating is firing — the tenant is bumping into a configured soft cap. No infra deploys in that window.

Raj: quick read of configs shows tenant quota record: `tenant_quota_vpc_nova` -> limit_rps: 500, burst_tokens: 1000. Customer contract file indicates they should have a higher burst but the override entry is missing (likely failed during onboarding).

Maya: ok — two immediate mitigation paths: 1) emergency temporary override (short TTL) to lift tenant cap; 2) route some traffic to fallback hosted pool to relieve dedicated pool pressure. Prefer doing both for safety. Need approvals for override audit.

Lin: Customer on the line, says they absolutely need immediate lift — production is impacted. Approves temporary lift and asks for TTL + audit.

Raj: I'll create a short-lived contract override and post audit link. Proposed payload: 
```
POST /internal/admin/overrides
Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>\n{
  "tenant_id": "nova-health",
  "override_type": "rate_limit",
  "limit_rps": 1500,
  "burst_tokens": 6000,
  "expires_at": "2026-03-15T12:40:00Z",
  "reason": "Emergency prod outage - customer request",
  "created_by": "raj"
}
```
Applying now. Will also add a revert job and Slack audit.

Andy: while Raj applies override I'm enabling route failover for nova-health to our hosted-burst pool (lower latency SLO but more capacity) and adding tenant isolation checks to ensure no cross-tenant spill. Commands I'm running: 
```
redwoodctl pool route set --tenant nova-health --primary nova-enterprise-1 --fallback hosted-burst-2 --enable-failover
redwoodctl tenant shield --tenant nova-health --mode enforce
```
I'm also whitelisting the customer's egress IPs in the per-tenant ACL to avoid unrelated network policies blocking requests.

Incident Bot: Override request submitted: override_id=OVR-20260315-331 (Raj). Audit: https://redwood.corp/audit/OVR-20260315-331 :white_check_mark:

Raj: override applied. Confirmed override effective at 12:26Z. System shows temporary limit_rps=1500 for nova-health. I set TTL 14 minutes (revert scheduled at 12:40Z).

Andy: failover route applied and shield enforced. Initial telemetry after changes: 
```
12:27Z 429_rate -> 6/s
12:28Z 429_rate -> 2/s
pool:nova-enterprise-1.utilization -> 0.72
hosted-burst-2.utilization -> 0.35
```
Looks stable but monitoring closely.

Maya: good work. Lin — customer confirms errors dropping to near zero, thanks them. Raj keep the audit ticket updated and confirm revert at TTL. I'm going to hand off the active watch to Raj for the next 20m — I'll sign out in 10m.

Lin: Customer says they're back to normal and will monitor. They asked for a postmortem on why the contract override didn't exist.

Raj: noted — creating follow-up item in backlog: PM-#4521 "reconcile enterprise onboarding overrides for NOVA-HEALTH" and incident ticket INC-20260315-NOVA. I'll keep watching until revert.

Maya: handing off to Raj for active mitigation. Next on-call (SRE rotation) will follow in 10m if needed. Thanks everyone. :v: 

Incident Bot: Reminder scheduled to auto-revert override at 2026-03-15T12:40Z unless extended. Reactions: :rotating_light: :white_check_mark: 

Raj: I'll extend the override only if telemetry shows sustained need AND we get explicit CS approval. If we extend we'll record justification in the audit and notify legal for contract implications.

Andy: logging all actions to the incident timeline. Will dump relevant debug bundles to the incident ticket in 5m.

Maya: logging off now — @Raj please escalate to eng-infra if we see any regressions.

Raj: acked. standing by.
